IC1: Patient included in an interventional study assessing treatment for active proctitis [OR] or distal proctosigmoiditis.
IC2: Patient with left sided, colitis [OR] or pancolitis.
IC3: Patient with severe proctitis (MAYO score ≥ 11 at inclusion).
IC5: Patient treated with immunosuppressive within 1 month before study inclusion.
IC6: Patient treated with corticosteroids within 2 weeks before study inclusion.
